source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the radius of a star (PDF 174).

blocks.text: Star ka radius Wien's displacement law aur Stefan-Boltzmann law dono se nikala ja sakta hai. Is ke liye pehle Wien's law se star ki surface ka temperature T nikalte hain (T = b/λmax). Phir radiant flux intensity (aur star ke faasle) se star ki luminosity nikalte hain (L = 4πd²F). Aakhir mein Stefan-Boltzmann law (L = 4πr²σT⁴) se star ka radius nikal lete hain: r = √(L/4πσT⁴).

blocks.title: Hal shuda misal (izafi)
blocks.problem: Sooraj ka spectrum taqreeban 500 nm par peak karta hai aur us ki luminosity 3.85 × 10²⁶ W hai. Us ka radius andaza lagayein.
steps: Wien's law: T = b/λmax = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K / 500 × 10⁻⁹ m = 5800 K
blocks.answer: r ≈ 6.9 × 10⁸ m, jo Sooraj ke naape gaye radius (taqreeban 7.0 × 10⁸ m) se milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Do stars ki luminosity barabar hai, lekin aik ki surface ka temperature doosre ka dugna hai. Un ke radius ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: L = 4πr²σT⁴, is liye barabar L ke liye r², 1/T⁴ ke proportional hai, yani r, 1/T² ke proportional. Garam star ka radius thande star ka 1/2² = 1/4 hai.

items: Wien's law se T; flux aur faasle se L.
